subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve Control UI turns across restarts

question: Is the focused v6 migration test sufficient for this compatibility-sensitive v7 schema change, or should landing require an installed-upgrade restart smoke with a populated agent database?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but accepting the remaining migration and cross-boundary replay risk is a maintainer judgment rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require installed-upgrade proof
options.body: Demonstrate migration and exactly-once recovery from a populated v2026.6.11 agent database before merge.

options.title: Accept focused coverage
options.body: Land using the existing migration test, live fresh-head restart scenario, and broad exact-head validation as sufficient evidence.

options.title: Split the migration
options.body: Pause and separate the status projection or broader recovery refactors if the upgrade blast radius is judged too large for this fix.

recommendation.title: Require installed-upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Demonstrate migration and exactly-once recovery from a populated v2026.6.11 agent database before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history and the current assignment connect this person to the affected SQLite, Gateway, and restart-recovery boundaries.
